_comment: System packages per package manager. 'gpu' = needed to build and run the graphics-card (Vulkan) engine, 'typing' = needed to type into other windows without GNOME's remote-control prompt, 'noise' = noise suppression (RNNoise; optional), 'pip' = Python packages installed into the app's own environment (no administrator rights) for the better voice detection (Silero VAD; optional). Keep in sync with install.sh (tests/sysdeps-test.sh checks this).
